summary.text: Donavan McKinney is a Michigan state representative from Detroit who won the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary over incumbent Rep. Shri Thanedar. Before the legislature he worked for a healthcare union, in the state House, and for a national climate organization. His campaign website lists priorities including union jobs, taxes on billionaires and corporations, environmental justice, Medicare for All and public education funding.

paragraphs.text: McKinney describes himself as a lifelong Detroiter who grew up in northeast Detroit, raised by his mother and grandmother; according to his campaign website, his family moved more than 13 times because of evictions.
Ballotpedia lists his birthplace as Detroit.

He attended Detroit Public Schools and earned a bachelor's degree in public policy from the University of Michigan (Gerald R. Ford School of Public Policy) in 2014, and his campaign website describes him as the first in his family to graduate from college.

McKinney's career before elected office included community engagement at the nonprofit Community Development Advocates of Detroit, a post as legislative director in the Michigan House of Representatives, and service as political director of SEIU Healthcare Michigan.
He later served as national political director of Climate Power, a national climate organization.
McKinney ran unsuccessfully in the 2020 Democratic primary for Michigan House District 3.

He won the November 2022 general election for Michigan House District 14 and took office in 2023, then won re-election in 2024 in the redrawn District 11, which covers northeast Detroit and southwest and west Warren.
In the Michigan House he was assigned to the Appropriations Committee (2023-2026).
He defeated incumbent Shri Thanedar in the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary for Michigan's 13th Congressional District.
